transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get us started on finalizing the guest-experience operating plan for opening night. As we all know, the red carpet will be set up outside the Orpheum Theater ahead of the 8:00 PM premiere screening. The current draft has the public entrance at the South Gate, a cap of 450 public attendees, and general press photography permitted along the carpet. Before we can lock this in, I need sign-off from security, talent services, and accessibility. Let's walk through any concerns department by department so we can get everyone comfortable and approved before guest arrival.
